properties.site-address: Kempshott Park Industrial Estate Longwood Copse Lane Basingstoke
properties.notes: The site received planning permission, subject to legal agreement, in September 2009 (BDB71030) for 63 dwellings and 2,740m2 commercial floorspace. A new application for 57 residential units was granted in August 2014 (13/00155/FUL). 48 units were completed in 2016/17 and Bellway have confirmed, through the annual site monitoring process, that the remainder will be completed in 2017/18.. Erection of 57 dwellings (48 houses & 9 apartments)
